action_items: IMPORTANT: running the full pre-existing backend suite (cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q, which uses -n 2 --dist loadscope from pytest.ini) causes several legacy test_tscheck_*.py files (collection archive/restore, admin catalog CRUD, order creation, session isolation) to leave permanent tscheck-prefixed residue in the LIVE shared database when run together: this pass found 2 stray catalog_groups active collections plus 6 archived tscheck catalog_groups, 2 stray products, 28 stray order_requests, and 2 stray users after one full-suite run. For a strictly-read-only verification task, do NOT run the full legacy suite; run only the new tscheck test files named in this report directly. All residue created during this iteration's investigation was identified and removed (via the product/catalog-groups admin DELETE endpoints and, for order_requests/users which have no delete endpoint, a direct Mongo cleanup) so the final verified state matches the acceptance matrix exactly: 4 products, 5 order-requests, 1 checkout session, 8 active categories, 3 active collections, no tscheck/test residue.

This appears to be unrelated to the legacy archive/restore test's own correctness (it passes its own assertions) but its cleanup is incomplete by design (it intentionally leaves one group 'active' after an archive->restore round trip and another 'archived' after a legacy-delete test, with no final teardown) which pollutes the shared app database on every run. Recommend the main agent add a teardown/fixture-scoped cleanup to test_tscheck_collection_archive_restore.py if this suite will be run again, or run it against an isolated/ephemeral DB.
